findings.text: The Vault page has no end-to-end test under tests/e2e/, so this flow was anchored from the drillbook (status not-executed) rather than from a real run. The seal/unlock and secret-lifecycle behaviour is described from reading, not from execution.
findings.suggestion: Add a vault e2e spec (assert sealed vs ready, add a secret, reveal it) or a drillbook step a capture can drive, so the next analysis anchors this flow to a real run.

findings.text: The Connectors page has no end-to-end test under tests/e2e/, so this flow was anchored from the drillbook (not-executed). The sealed-auth / security-messaging path is narrated from reading connectors-view and vault-audit, not from execution.
findings.suggestion: Add a connectors e2e spec that asserts the connected/sealed/unknown states with the vault locked and unlocked, so the security messaging is covered by a real run.

findings.text: The embedded Drill fitting surface (/fitting/drill) has no end-to-end test, so this flow was anchored from the drillbook (not-executed). The dynamic [fittingId] route and the view-contract resolution are described from reading.
findings.suggestion: Add an e2e spec that visits /fitting/drill and asserts a usable embedded surface renders (not raw JSON, not blank), so the resolver path is exercised.

findings.text: The embedded Kanban fitting surface (/fitting/kanban-loop) has no end-to-end test, so this flow was anchored from the drillbook (not-executed). The own-port live-embed path (status file read, loopback-vs-tailnet URL resolution, board iframe) is narrated from reading.
findings.suggestion: Add an e2e spec that visits /fitting/kanban-loop and asserts the board embed renders when the own-port fitting is up (and a graceful down-state when it is not).

findings.text: The e2e "Quarters Skills: create -> edit -> delete a loose skill" recorded a clean create-and-save (all four captured actions passed), but the run FAILED at a downstream assertion, so the edit and delete halves of the cycle were not verified in the analysis sandbox. The flow is narrated honestly as such.
findings.suggestion: Re-run this spec in an environment where a loose skill can be created, edited and deleted end to end, or split it so the create, edit and delete paths assert independently; then re-anchor this flow from a passing run.
